newsitem.title: USA: Catalyst Intl looks for revenue recovery.
newsitem.headline: Catalyst Intl looks for revenue recovery.

text.p: Catalyst International Inc, reporting weaker third-quarter revenues, said it expects a recovery in the fourth quarter.
"We had a number of prospects throughout the (third) quarter, but did not close as many deals as expected," said president Vaemond Crane in a statement.

"We continue to have a large pipeline and anticipate recovery in the fourth quarter. However, the expected recovery must be tempered by the lengthening of the sales cycle and other sales factors out of our control," Crane added.

Earlier Wednesday, the software developer posted third quarter revenues of $4.7 million compared to $5.6 million a year earlier. It recorded a loss of $0.15 per share compared to year-ago earnings of $0.12 per share.
